notes: The second 'of' (t008) is the distributed realization of the one לְ whose scope covers both members (rule 25), not an added word.
Both עִם units take 'even as' whole, since no conjunction morpheme stands beside the preposition (rule 16).
s024 keeps its fronted 'doth', because אֵיךְ already holds an English word of its own (rule 17's second limit).
